record.question: Under MLP Amendment Act 2025, contravention of section 5(1) (c) manufacture liquor (d) possess or use or keep for use any material, utensils, implements, apparatus; chemical or compound whatsoever for manufacture of liquor; and (e) construct any brewery, distillery, winery, bottling plant or ware house, or a such place on conviction shall be punishable with imprisonment __________.
options: up to 3 years with fine Rs 5,000.
not less than 1 month which may extend to 2 years with fine.
not less than 3 months which may extend to 3 years with fine not less than Rs.5,000 which may extend to Rs.10,000.
not less than 3 months which may extend to 5 years with fine not less than Rs.10,000 which may extend to Rs.1 lakh.
